legal.termsMeta: Terms of use for OrzuAi at www.orzuai.com.
legal.privacyHtml:
This Privacy Policy explains how OrzuAi (“we”, “us”, “our”), operating the service at https://www.orzuai.com, collects and uses information when you use our website and dashboard. By using OrzuAi, you agree to this policy.

Contact: support@orzuai.com.

1. Who we are

OrzuAi is a software product that helps creators generate, edit, and optionally publish short-form videos (including YouTube Shorts). We process account data and content you create or upload so the product can work.

2. Information we collect

Depending on how you use OrzuAi, we may process account data, YouTube/Google OAuth data if connected, content you create, usage and technical logs, and payment metadata via our payment provider.

3. How we use information

We use data to provide and improve OrzuAi, authenticate and secure accounts, generate and store media you request, publish to connected channels when you ask, communicate about the service, and comply with law.

4. Sharing

We use processors such as hosting, auth, storage, AI, and email providers. We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose information if required by law.

5. Retention & security

We retain data as long as needed for the service and legal obligations. We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards.

6. Your rights

Depending on your region, you may request access, correction, deletion, or export of your data by contacting support@orzuai.com.

7. Children

OrzuAi is not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country).

8. Changes

We may update this policy. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated policy.
legal.termsHtml:
These Terms govern your use of OrzuAi at https://www.orzuai.com. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these Terms.

Contact: support@orzuai.com.

1. The service

OrzuAi provides AI-assisted tools for video, Shorts, clipping, presentations, editing, and media libraries. Features may change as we improve the product.

2. Accounts

You must provide accurate information and keep credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.

3. Acceptable use

Do not misuse the service, infringe others’ rights, upload illegal content, attempt to break security, or abuse AI/generation quotas.

4. Your content

You retain rights to content you upload. You grant OrzuAi a license to host and process it to operate the service. You must have rights to any media you upload or publish.

5. AI outputs

AI outputs may be inaccurate or similar to other content. You are responsible for reviewing outputs before publishing.

6. Third-party services

YouTube, Google, and other integrations are subject to their terms. We are not responsible for third-party outages or policy changes.

7. Billing

Paid plans, if offered, are billed via our payment provider. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law.

8. Disclaimer & liability

The service is provided “as is”. To the maximum extent allowed by law, OrzuAi is not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

9. Termination

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. You may stop using OrzuAi at any time.

10. Changes

We may update these Terms. Continued use after changes means you accept them.
